​

    do_sample=True,

    num_return_sequences=5
)

for output in outputs:

​

distributed.merge: the merger folds each worker checkpoint into a running fp32 sum as it arrives, waits at most 150 s past the first arrival, and publishes global_b.pt
distributed.outer_optimizer: plain average (momentum 0, lr 1); outer Nesterov was tried and raised held-out CE
distributed.phase: workers adopt a new global as soon as it appears (checked every 10 steps) and take its step counter, so the whole fleet starts each 150-step interval together
distributed.sharding: each worker takes every Nth document of the base corpus from its own shuffle; the extra sources are read unsharded

## Model description

[CodeGen2](https://github.com/salesforce/CodeGen2) is a family of autoregressive language models for **program synthesis**, introduced in the paper:

Four model sizes are released: `1B`, `3.7B`, `7B`, `16B`.

For regular causal sampling, simply generate completions given the context:
```python

generated_ids = model.generate(input_ids, max_length=128)
print(tokenizer.decode(generated_ids[0], skip_special_tokens=True))
```
